author: GamingBolt
description:
The latest State of Play has just concluded and there have been a ton of new game announcements and updates. From the likes of Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol.  2, a new Castlevania game to updates on games like Silent Hill: Townfall and Saros, this showcase was packed with a lot of interesting stuff.

Check out 20 of the biggest game reveals at the latest PlayStation State of Play event.
title: 20 Huge State of Play Game Announcements You MISSED
